builds.hypothesis: R3 is400+0.8 AP magic; pre-applied Curse adds10% true damage from magic damage taken. MR penetration improves magic and its associated Curse amount. Deathcap amplifies AP; Shadowflame supplies15 flat magic penetration/conditional lowHP magic-true amplification; Void supplies40% MR penetration; Banshee/Zhonya supply105 AP each; Riftmaker supplies HP-to-AP and verified8% combat ramp.
